title: Launch lock, process adoption, drain and restart reconciliation
description: Objective: everything between an activation grant and a proven-terminal or reconciled attempt for one Claude node. SPIDR child 2 of 4, split from task-312c1de3c76a4f1dbd8da5c34e629b0e per human-approved 4-child decomposition 2026-08-08 (coarse split: lock/adoption/observation AND cancel/drain/restart deliberately share this task). Design authority: pinned design lines 798 (launch lock, bootstrap credential, duplicate delivery, SUSPECT), 786-787 (reconciliation table), 382/568 (drain on invalidation/remove), 336 (lifecycle). Deliverable: launch-lock protocol records (OS-exclusive lock identity, one-time bootstrap credential registration — lock/credential facts are caller-supplied observations, no syscalls); duplicate delivery adopts the registered process or exits before provider launch; process observation intake over caller-supplied EXITED{code}|SIGNALLED{signal}|UNOBSERVED bound to the adapter's claude-observation and claude-cancel-reconcile outcome shapes; uncertain ARMED/lock state becomes SUSPECT and is never auto-relaunched; the design-786/787 reconciliation: pre-activation intents with every resource proven absent/released are atomically tombstoned with lease/slot fenced-released, budget settled, attempt terminalized by strongest typed reason (RELEASED additionally requires an exact safe handoff); any active/unknown resource forces attempt DRAINING with capacity/NodeRun hold retained until adapter reconciliation, then strongest disposition; restart reconstruction re-derives exactly one legal state from durable records, never a premature terminal. NOT in scope: real OS spawn/job-object/lock syscalls (port-shaped observations; OS wiring is a later task), daemon services (child 3), seeded race harness (child 4), Codex, multi-node. Hard dependencies: Effect intent lifecycle and one-use activation gate (task-2580a578, child 1) for intent records and grant shapes; Claude runtime adapter (task-5ff2b39d, DONE) for observation/cancel-reconcile shapes. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/supervisor/** additions and focused tests (do not rewrite child 1's files; extend). Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: Duplicate delivery with a registered process ADOPTS it (same process identity in the outcome) and without a registration EXITS before provider launch; both arms asserted with their stable codes, and the duplicate-delivery outcome matrix asserts set-equality so a blind-relaunch outcome kind cannot exist unnoticed.
Uncertain ARMED or lock state maps to SUSPECT with a stable code; no SUSPECT or UNKNOWN state can yield a launch grant, asserted against the production surface.

Every design-786/787 reconciliation row has a fixture: all-resources-proven-released terminalizes by strongest typed reason in one step; any active/unknown resource yields DRAINING with capacity held until adapter reconciliation; the row list is asserted so a sweep generating zero rows fails.

Restart reconstruction over seeded pre-crash states lands each in exactly one legal post state (asserted outcome set), never a premature terminal label; RELEASED requires an exact safe handoff and its absence is a distinct refusal.
The focused runner typecheck and test command exits 0 and only explicitly owned paths are staged and committed.
taskRails: Follow pinned design lines 798/786-787/382/568; process termination is best-effort, fencing is authoritative — no post-activation business mutation may be accepted even while DRAINING.
No child_process, spawn, kill, Date.now, or Math.random — all OS facts are caller-supplied observations; uncertainty stays SUSPECT or UNKNOWN and never gains authority.
Do not add package dependencies; mirror foreign shapes structurally with pinned version literals.
Use TDD. Keep each production source focused, target <=250 lines, split before 400. Commit by explicit pathspec only.
Assert the reason code and refusing layer; mutation-verify failure paths at the mechanism's single source.

implementationPlan.description: Implement packages/runner/src/supervisor/launch-lock.ts to green. Pure module, no syscalls: every OS fact arrives as a caller-supplied observation and every timestamp as a caller-supplied canonical UTC string (task rail 2 forbids child_process, spawn, kill, Date.now and Math.random outright). Surface: a frozen LaunchLockRegistration record (lockIdentity, wrapperIdentity, processIdentity, bootstrapCredentialDigest, registeredAt) validated with effect-shape.ts's existing isRef/isDigest/exactRecord/hasOnlyOwnStringKeys — write no new validators; registerLaunchLock refusing a reused credential; and resolveDuplicateDelivery returning a frozen discriminated outcome over an EXPORTED FROZEN kind list (ADOPTED | EXIT_BEFORE_LAUNCH | SUSPECT) so step 3's set-equality sweep has a production-side list to compare against. ADOPTED carries the adopted process identity; SUSPECT is terminal for this decision and never yields a relaunch. Observation intake accepts ClaudeProcessExit (EXITED{code} | SIGNALLED{signal} | UNOBSERVED) and binds a ClaudeReconciliation by digest rather than re-deriving its outcome — the adapter owns that verdict. REDACTION IS A SECURITY PROPERTY HERE: the bootstrap credential is compared as a digest and must never appear in a refusal message, a detail field, or an outcome; same for lease tokens and expected observation digests (effect-kernel.ts:118). Refuse through supervisorFailure(code, layer, message, detail) with layer LAUNCH_LOCK. Target under 250 lines; split before 400 and give the split a focused name.

implementationPlan.description: Implement packages/runner/src/supervisor/drain-reconciliation.ts to green. It resolves one row of the step-5 table from (attempt slice state, effect state, resource facts, optional ClaudeReconciliation) and returns a frozen outcome: either TERMINALIZED carrying the strongest typed reason and, for RELEASED, the exact safe handoff it required, or DRAINING carrying what stays held — capacity and the NodeRun hold — until adapter reconciliation. Resource facts are caller-supplied classifications (PROVEN_RELEASED | ACTIVE | UNKNOWN); ACTIVE and UNKNOWN both force DRAINING, and the UNKNOWN arm is the one that must never be optimistically collapsed into released — epic rail 4 keeps unverifiable evidence at UNKNOWN with no authority. An input matching no table row refuses DRAIN_ROW_NOT_ADMITTED rather than falling through to a default, and a reconciliation that leaves a resource unaccounted refuses DRAIN_RESOURCE_UNRECONCILED. Disposition upgrades read the strength order exported by drain-table.ts and refuse DRAIN_DISPOSITION_NOT_MONOTONIC on any attempted downgrade — monotonicity is enforced at this single source so step 9 can mutate it here and see red. Consume the lifecycle's MUST_DRAIN arm rather than re-deriving when a drain is required; it is already a distinct LifecycleOutcome kind, not a refusal. Target under 250 lines; split before 400.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red for restart reconstruction — DoD 4. Create packages/runner/src/supervisor/restart-reconstruction.test.ts seeding pre-crash durable record sets across the interesting shapes: a committed activation whose grant is CONSUMED but whose attempt never reached RUNNING; a partial activation commit (the case child 1's validateActivationCommit already detects); a registered launch lock with no observation; an observation with no registration; a DRAINING attempt with an unreconciled resource; a terminal attempt with a nonterminal effect; and a RELEASED candidate both with and without its exact safe handoff. For each, assert the reconstruction lands in EXACTLY ONE legal post state by comparing against a hand-written expected outcome SET — asserted for set equality and non-zero length, so a reconstruction that widens its answers or generates nothing fails. Two properties get their own assertions because they are the ones that would be silently wrong: no seed may produce a premature terminal label (missing or unverifiable evidence must land UNKNOWN or SUSPECT, refusing RESTART_PREMATURE_TERMINAL if a terminal is attempted without proof), and RELEASED without its exact safe handoff must be a DISTINCT refusal, RESTART_SAFE_HANDOFF_ABSENT, not folded into a generic incoherence code. Incoherent record sets refuse RESTART_RECORDS_INCOHERENT. Every assertion names code and layer. Red.

implementationPlan.description: Implement packages/runner/src/supervisor/restart-reconstruction.ts to green. Pure re-derivation over durable records only — effect intent, attempt slice, claim, grant, tombstone, launch-lock registration, and any bound reconciliation. It must produce exactly one legal state, never a set and never a guess: where the records admit more than one reading, that ambiguity is itself the answer and resolves to UNKNOWN or SUSPECT with a stable code, because epic rail 4 forbids unverifiable evidence from gaining authority. It must never label a terminal it cannot prove; a terminal claim without its evidence refuses RESTART_PREMATURE_TERMINAL. RELEASED is the strictest arm and requires the exact safe handoff, refusing RESTART_SAFE_HANDOFF_ABSENT when it is missing — a distinct code, so a reviewer can tell 'no handoff' from 'records disagree'. Reuse child 1's validateActivationCommit for partial-commit detection rather than re-implementing that check, and route drain decisions through drain-reconciliation.ts rather than duplicating the table. Refuse at layer RESTART. Target under 250 lines; split before 400.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
(1) SPLIT OR NOT — decided NOT to split, though governor-eae4fc53 pre-authorized one. The human deliberately approved this coarse pairing (lock/adoption/observation AND cancel/drain/restart share this task by design), so re-splitting would override a human decision, and it fits: 11 steps / 9 distinct files, one slot of headroom on each hard threshold (>12 steps, >10 files reject). Compression was NOT how it was made to fit — the 786/787 reconciliation is largely exported frozen DATA plus one resolver, which is dense in behaviour and thin in files.
(2) MIRROR OR IMPORT THE CLAUDE SHAPES — decided IMPORT. Task rail 3 ('mirror foreign shapes structurally with pinned version literals') applies to @moe/scheduler lease shapes, which are out-of-package. `ClaudeProcessExit`, `ClaudeReconciliation` and `ClaudeReconciledOutcome` live in `packages/runner/src/providers/claude/` — the SAME package. Import them directly; a structural re-declaration here would be a second source of truth that drifts silently.
(3) WHERE THE NEW CODES LIVE — decided: extend `effect-kernel.ts`'s frozen vocabularies rather than starting a private code union. The kernel comments call it 'the closed refusal vocabulary', and a second closed vocabulary beside it defeats the point. APPEND only — never reorder or remove an existing entry, since child 1's tests assert against those arrays.
(4) LOCK IDENTITY — decided to EXTEND, not re-model. `EffectClaim` already carries `wrapperIdentity` and `lockIdentity`, and `effect-activation.ts:176-179` already refuses `ACTIVATION_LOCK_IDENTITY_MISMATCH` when they disagree.
